layout.handedness: Preserve retained Cyl3 positive-phi and physical basis; storage r,z,phi does not license a sign flip in cross products.

measures.integration_endpoints: Independent polynomial oracles use exact actual binary64 endpoints; CFL spacing remains configured dx, not cancellation-prone endpoint subtraction.
measures.full_physical_integrals: Multiply per-unit-azimuth mass, energy, gravity moments and angular momentum by 2*pi consistently.

state_and_projection.representation: Existing three orthonormal momentum-density PWC coefficients, energy and species only; no extra authoritative J/ell state.
state_and_projection.angular_momentum: J=sum Mphi*W (and 2*pi for full physical integral); not sum r_mid*Mphi*V.
state_and_projection.initialization: Retain generic Init point sampling as declared PWC projection. Exact coefficient fixtures remain prescribed values; analytic projection/truncation error is separate from discrete conservation and PDE convergence.

Euler.no_double_count: The torque divergence absorbs the continuous phi-curvature term by product-rule cancellation. Do not add the point phi source again.
Euler.execution: One existing Riemann/reconstruction/traversal path, common geometry-moment weights; no RZ flux/state/control hierarchy or extra full-domain pass.
Euler.retained_Cyl1: Original pressure-only radial source semantics preserved; azimuth index alone does not activate swirl.

axis_and_boundary.axis: r=0 face, Ar=Tr=0 exactly; no radial epsilon.
axis_and_boundary.owner: Existing CoordinateBoundary/seam/physical-boundary machinery, including AMR donors; no phi+pi shift of z or substitute ordinary wall.
axis_and_boundary.axial_boundaries: Ordinary existing periodic/reflecting/outflow/user semantics only after corresponding qualification.

AMR_and_diffusion.transfer: V weights for mass/E/rhoX; W weights for J; same state slots and common transaction.
AMR_and_diffusion.reflux: T-compatible integrated angular flux/traction in existing face/register owner, consistent with W update.
AMR_and_diffusion.admissibility: Retain numerical criteria; veto inadmissible coarsen/transfer instead of silently clipping energy/J to pass.
AMR_and_diffusion.viscosity: Shared symmetric stress, connection/shear terms retained even with partial_phi=0; torque and energy work consistent.
AMR_and_diffusion.lifecycle: Reuse ordinary rollback/regrid/cache; no RZ authoritative state or persistent buffer subsystem.

time.CFL: Common owner on active dr,dz only, no manufactured phi CFL.
time.rotation: Source/rotation stability and correct physical-endpoint step counts need independent CYL-2 evidence; fixed-step cost is not physical-endpoint qualification.

gravity.separation: Geometry has no field/solve/selection/work/receipt/cache ownership. Optional gravity owner owns all actual gravity operations and conservation coupling.
gravity.off: No gravity solve or gravity-specific field allocation; existing generic no-op stage timing is allowed.
gravity.external_components: Existing g_x/g_y/g_z are stored source-slot components. On native RZ these mean (g_r,g_axial,g_phi), not Cartesian projection or new aliases/defaults.
gravity.body_torque: rho*g_phi*W integrated over dt; work is M dot g. Axisymmetric self gravity has g_phi=0; an explicitly prescribed azimuthal body force is physical torque.
gravity.manufactured: Phi=a*(r^2+z^2), laplacian=6*a, g=(-2*a*r,-2*a*z,0), prescribed boundary first.
gravity.isolated: Actual axisymmetric 3D Newtonian mass/ring boundary in gravity owner; phi=0 point mass or 2D planar/log Green is invalid. No revival of old ring memo/controller.
